definition.0.5: t_weak <= spearman < t_strong  (meets or beats frozen probe)
definition.1.0: spearman >= t_strong  (meets or beats strong-oracle bar)

notes: T_weak equals the calibrated frozen mean-pool Ridge Spearman on the private test set. T_strong is a fixed strong-oracle bar below the successful Codex run (~0.57). T_implausible is a contamination tripwire: measured frozen probe is 0.546+/-0.005 (n=8) and the best fine-tune ever observed is 0.5709, so no honest run approaches 0.75, while a model trained on the reconstructed test set scores ~0.99.
